title: National Museum of Singapore Monument Building
geometryBasis: Fitted historic frontage and projecting porch from the named native outline. The National Heritage Board documents the original 27 metre dome height and classical orders.
sectionBasis: The 1908 signed plate documents the long ground-storey arcades, upper rectangular window bays, pediment and arcaded central entrance. The current museum describes retained Neo-Palladian composition, white historic facade and fish-scaled zinc dome.
limitations: The model covers the original Monument Building frontage and rotunda. Later rear gallery wings and the independent modern glass rotunda are outside this exterior scope.
The archive confirms the original composition. Exact rear openings, roof slopes and small heraldic and floral ornament are representative.
